q1.explanationZh: 第一段说寿司至少有1800年的历史。

evidence.quote: It has a history of at least 1,800 years.

q2.explanationZh: 第二段说公元200年时寿司是一种保存食物的方法，preserving food 就是 keeping food。

q3.explanationZh: 第三段说把一片新鲜的鱼放在长方形米饭上，这就是现在常见的吃法。

evidence.quote: placed a piece of fresh fish on top of an

q4.explanationZh: 现在常见的吃法是19世纪初形成的。A不对，他只是改进；B寿司最早出现在中国；C最后一段说寿司还在变。

evidence.quote: That is now the common way of eating Japanese sushi.

q5.explanationZh: in 前面 first TV 后要填名词，appear 的名词是 appearance（出场，露面）。

evidence.quote: The earliest form of sushi appeared in

q6.explanationZh: enjoy 后面要名词，popular 的名词是 popularity（受欢迎）。

evidence.quote: Sushi is popular all over the world.

q7.explanationZh: since its 后面要名词，create 的名词是 creation（创造，创立）。

evidence.quote: People create new styles of sushi every year.

q8.explanationZh: 空格修饰后面的 used（形容词性），要用副词 commonly（普遍地）。

evidence.quote: That is now the common way of eating Japanese sushi.

q9.explanationZh: at the ... of the book 要名词，begin 的名词是 beginning（开头）。

evidence.quote: The earliest form of sushi appeared in

q10.explanationZh: 画线部分 to ferment 表示目的，用 Why 提问；原句是 was placed，所以 Why was fish placed in rice?

evidence.quote: Fish was placed in rice to

q11.explanationZh: 被动语态用 was + 过去分词：was placed by ...

evidence.quote: placed a piece of fresh fish on top of an

q12.explanationZh: 前半句是肯定句，后半句用否定：isn’t it？

evidence.quote: That is now the common way of eating Japanese sushi.

q13.explanationZh: 主语 you，后面接 will have to wait（将不得不等），再接 at least an hour（至少一小时）：You will have to wait at least an hour.

evidence.quote: It has a history of at least 1,800 years.
